notes: Page is the Lochinvar commercial pool heater page; it states the serial styles shown are utilized with all Lochinvar brand systems (Aquas, Armor, Cadet, Copper-Fin, Copper-Fin II, Crest, EnergyRite, FTXL, Knight, Knight XL, Lochinvar, Noble, Power-fin, Shield, Squire, SYNC and others). Styles are written here from this page's own text, not inherited, so no usesStylesOf is claimed. SHIPPED styles are those whose year (and week/month where present) is stated in retrievable text: style-2 (year/week digits), style-4 year-only, style-6 year-only, style-8 (year/month digits). HELD, NOT SHIPPED: style-1 (KJ-1000130: year = 1st letter, month = 2nd letter, both letter tables image-only, Lochinvar-Style-1_Serial-Number.png); style-3 (month letter table image-only, Lochinvar-Style-3 slides, and the page's two example forms disagree in length: header J-93001 vs detail J-93 0001, so the normalized shape is doubtful); style-5 (month letter table image-only, Lochinvar-Style-5_Serial-Number.png, and the page's two example forms disagree: header J93-1030F vs detail J93 12030F); style-7 (5Y013: month digit 5 is text-stated but year is the 2nd letter, whose table is image-only, Lochinvar-Style-7_Serial-Number.png, and a style cannot ship without a year field). Year-only shipped styles omit month deliberately: the month letter tables are image-only and are not guessed; a later image pass can upgrade them to year+month.

styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = year, 3-4 = week (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open ranges. Page example 1142N012345.

styles.era: 13-character serials, letter + 2 digits + letter + 8 digits (year only shipped)
styles.notes: Page positions 2-3 = year digits (1-based); month is the 1st letter whose table is image-only (Lochinvar-Style-4 slides) and is not shipped. Page example A07H00123456.
Page positions 2-3 = year digits (1-based); month is the 1st letter whose table is image-only (Lochinvar-Style-6_Serial-Number.png) and is not shipped. Page example M78013.

styles.era: 10-digit numeric serials, last four digits = year and month
styles.notes: Page states the last four digits represent the year and month. Order is year-then-month: the page example's last four digits are 9708, which only reads as year 97, month 08 (month 97 would be invalid). No other style in this file uses the all-digit 10-character shape, so there is no collision with style-2 (which contains a letter).
